scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @skillhub/shared build && pnpm --filter @skillhub/codex-protocol build && concurrently -k -n catalog,bridge,web "pnpm --filter @skillhub/catalog dev" "pnpm --filter @skillhub/bridge dev" "pnpm --filter @skillhub/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @skillhub/shared build && pnpm --filter @skillhub/codex-protocol build && pnpm --filter @skillhub/catalog build && pnpm --filter @skillhub/bridge build && pnpm --filter @skillhub/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @skillhub/shared build && pnpm --filter @skillhub/codex-protocol build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
